dialogue: Duniya ki nazar mein mare hue log kabhi zinda nahi hote ... varna zindagi khud pareshaan ho jaati hai
Rasam nibhane ke liye havan mein ghee dalna hi padta hai ... lekin phir ussi aag se ghar bhi jalaya ja sakta hai
Mohabbat reet rivaaz nahi maanti ... aur na hi woh lafzo ki mohtaj hai
Yeh daulat bhi kya cheez hai ... jiske pass jitni bhi aati hai ... kam hi lagti hai
Main markar bhi na mar saka ... aur na hi jeekar jee sakta hoon
Waqt ke aage kisi ki nahi chalti ... isliye waqt par hi chod dijiye
Prem ki koi seema nahi hoti aur naa hi uska koi wazan hota hai ... prem ka koi hisaab kitaab nahi hota ... is liye toh kehte hai ki prem hi ishwar hai aur ishwar hi prem
Tum kya samajhte ho kanoon koi khilona hai, mujrimon ke samne bauna hai? ... arre ab toh wohi hoga joh hona hai
Mujhpe aaisa aarop ... ab dekh mera prakop
Atyachari, durachari ... tu jaanta hai main hoon bal-brahmachari
Degree se sirf certificate milta hai ... akal nahi
Assi tussi piyange lassi
Saatve asmaan ko choone ki koshish karte karte ... yeh main pataal mein pahunch gaya hoon
Agar main chota kaam karoonga na ... toh chota hi ban kar reh jaonga
Phatte huye joote ke chedh se us paar dekhoge na, haqeeqat nazar aayegi ... joota bada duniya choti nazar aayegi ... kismat phatke haath mein aa jayegi (-Nana Patekar)
Shukriya toh gairon ka ada kiya jaata hai ... apno ka nahi (-Amrita Singh)
Sunday ke baad monday, rupaye ke char ande ... khaye kisi aur ne dande, ab raj kar rahe hai mushtande (-Nana Patekar)
Is Bambai shehar mein jhagda karne se sar phoote na phoote ... lekin mohabbat karne se dil tootne ka guarantee (-Nana Patekar)
Sachai aur imaandari ki buniyaad par jhoot aur fareb ka mahal bahut dino tak nahi tik sakta ... woh gir jaata hai (-Juhi Chawla)
Aaise naukri kaise milegi bhai ... is ulti duniya ko sar ke bal khade hokar dekhoge toh seedhi nazar aayegi ... apni arzi par wazan nahi rakha, hawa mein udh jayegi (-Nana Patekar)
Sadak pe tamasha karne waala aur dekhne waala ... dono ka taqdeer kharab hai (-Nana Patekar)
Hindu ko namaskar nahi bolega, Musalman ko salaam nahi karega, Christian ko good morning nahi bolega ... kyun ki apan yahan language ka lafda karne nahi aiyla (-Nana Patekar)
Duniya mein tu aayi hai ashk peene ke liye ... muskurana hi padega tujhe jeene ke liye (-Jetendra)
Aisa hamesha zaroori nahi hai ki jis raaste par maa baap chale ... ussi raaste par aulad bhi chale (-SRK)
Jitna bada aadmi, utna hi lamba intezaar (-Raza Murad)
Har tawaif dalle se zyada pyar ke shabd se nafrat karti hai (-Divya Bharti)
Haar tab hoti hai jab haar maan li jaye (-SRK)
Pyar bheek se nahi milta (-SRK)
Dalle aur pille ke saath ek jaisa suluk karna chahiye ... agar baat se na maane, toh laat maarni chahiye (-SRK)
Ladki aisi honi chahiye ... thodi si namkeen, thodi si khatti, thodi si meethi ... rang aisa ki chandni ki ujaale mein jaise thoda sa shaam ka andhera shamil ho (-SRK)
Bachchon ke liye kitaabein likhna bahut asaan hai ... magar unke liye loriyan gaana bahut mushkil hai (-Amrita Singh)
Jaane kya badalon ke darmiyan saazish hui ... uska ghar mitti ka tha, uske hi ghar baarish hui (-Sonu Walia)
Sar par chhat ho na ho ... paon ke neeche ek zameen ka tudka toh chahiye (-Divya Bharti)
Khilono aur tohfo ki bachchon ko itni bhook nahi hoti jitni maa baap ke pyar ki (-Sonu Walia)
Jhoot ka bhi rajneeti mein ek khaas maqam hai (-Sonu Walia)
Jalan ka bhi mohabbat mein ek khaas maqam hai (-Sonu Walia)
Sharton par pyar nahi hota (-Mithun Chakraborty)
Unke dekhne se joh aa jaati hai chehre pe raunak ... woh samajhte hai bimaar ka haal achcha hai (-Mithun Chakraborty)
Jawani bhi aisi hi car hai jis mein brake nahi hota (-Sushma Seth)
Yeh zindagi, milna bichadna ... sab lakeeron ka khel hai (-Mithun Chakraborty)
Chor jab maal pakadta hai, toh usse tijori thodi yaad rehti hai? (-Mohan Agashe)
Sharifon ka libaaz pehenne se ... awargi sharafat nahi ban jaati (-Unknown)
Halaat ki majboori se agar insaan keechad mein gir jaaye ... toh uska khoon ganda nahi ho jaata (-Jeetendra)
Khata ek pal ki hoti hai ... lekin uski sazaa saalon saal tak bhugatni padti hai (-Sushma Seth)

Race mein daudte waqt khiladi ke paon jitni tezzi se uthte aur girte hai ... utni hi tezzi se naachte waqt kisi tawaif ke paon uthte aur girte hai ... speed barabar hoti hai, par khiladi apni race jeet leta hai ... aur tawaif naachte naachte ek hi jagah par apna dum todh deti hai (-Kabir Bedi)
Ishq ke saamne zamane waale haarte aaye hai (-Kabir Bedi)
Yaadon ka insaan ki zindagi mein ek khaas maqam hai (-Sonu Walia)
Kabhi kabhi jeetne ke liye kuch haarna bhi padta hai ... aur haar kar jeetne waale ko baazigar kehte hai (-SRK)
Udne ki baat parinde karte hai ... tutte huye par nahi (-SRK)
Ab sailaab aayega Madan Chopra ... sailaab aayega (-SRK)
Burai milne mein nahi hai ... burai chup chupkar milne mein hai (-SRK)
Kitaabein mehbooba se behtar hoti hai ... atleast intezaar toh nahi karwarti (-SRK)
Daud zindagi ka ho yah motor car ka ... maine kabhi haarna nahi seekha (-Dalip Tahil)
Naam badalne se ... insaan ka chehra aur uska jurm nahi badal jaata (-Kajol)
Tumhari haalat ek us aphahij jaisi ho gayi hai ... jisse chalne ke liye baisaakhi ki zaroorat toh hai ... lekin usse pakadne ke liye haath nahi hai (-SRK)
Maa bete ka bhavishya chunti hai, duayen chunti hai ... uske jism ke tukde nahi (-Rakhee Gulzar)
Ab har cheez meri hai ... aur har cheez ka maalik main hoon (-Dalip Tahil)
Tune mujhe power of attorney nahi ... apni taqdeer ka woh kohra panna de diya hai ... jis par main jab chahoon teri barbadi ka ithihaas likh sakta hoon (-SRK)
Zindagi mein tu kabhi sukhi nahi ho sakta ... mere bachchon ki hai tera sukh chain sab kuch cheen legi ... tu tabha ho jayega ... yeh ek maa ki baddua hai (-Rakhee Gulzar)
I love you KKKKK ... Kiran (-SRK)
Sachchi mohabbat ko pechaanne ke liye aankhon ki nahi ... dil ki zaroorat hoti hai (-SRK)
Naam loonga toh woh badnaam ho jayegi (-SRK)
Joh taar se nikli hai, woh dhun sabne suni hai ... joh saans pe ghuzri hai, woh kis dil ko pata hai (-SRK)
Pardes mein agar apne saath ho na ... toh desh ban jaata hai ... varna desh bhi pardes lagta hai (-SRK)
Mohabbat na ho toh aadmi saans toh zaroor leta hai ... magar zinda nahi rehta hai (-Sunny Deol)
Uski yaad ek amanat hai ... ek bahut hi haseen, bahut hi pyari, bahut hi keemti amanat hai (-SRK)
Pyar jab hadh se guzar jaye toh pooja ban jata hai ... aur pooja bahek jaye toh junoon (-Unknown)
Joh cheez mujhe nahi milti ... main usse barbaad kar deta hoon (-SRK)
Itna bada jhoot mat bol ... ki jhoot bhi sharminda ho jaye (-Madhuri Dixit)
Aurat maryam bankar zindagi de sakti hai ... toh chandi bankar zindagi le bhi sakti hai (-Madhuri Dixit)
Teri maut hi mere zakhmon ka ilaaj hai (-Madhuri Dixit)
Yeh sirf ek safed sari nahin ... ek vidhwa ka gehna hai (-Madhuri Dixit)
Main joh bhi kaam karta hoon ... apni sharton pe hi karta hoon (-SRK)
Sansar ne aurat ko maa ke roop mein dekha hai, bahen ke roop mein dekha hai, beti ke roop mein dekha hai ... magar chandi ke roop mein nahi dekha (-Madhuri Dixit)
Ek aurat apne seene mein agar daya aur mamta ka sagar rakhti hai ... toh nafrat ki aaisi aag bhi rakhti hai ... jiski choti si chingaari kisiko bhi jalakar rakh kar sakti hai (-Madhuri Dixit)
Tumhare liye sindoor ki keemat chahe kuch bhi na ho ... magar yeh ek suhagan ke liye anmol hai (-Madhuri Dixit)
Aurat ki sehan-shakti dharti ki tarah hoti hai ... joh har zulm seh leti hai, magar jab uske khroad ka jwalamukhi phatta hai ... toh woh sabko tabah kar deti hai (-Madhuri Dixit)
Zindagi mein joh hota hai woh socha nahi hota ... aur joh socha jata hai woh kabhi hota nahi ... aur joh kabhi nahi hota, woh kabhi kabhi ho jata hai (-Kajol)
Mere bete aayenge, mere Karan Arjun aayenge ... zameen ki chaati phad ke aayenge, aasman ka seena cheer ke aayenge (-Rakhi Gulzar)
Mere dushmano ko sar chupane ke liye jagah dene waalon ... main tumhari chittaon ko jalne ke liye jagah nahi doonga (-Amrish Puri)

Daulat se insaan keemti bistar khareed sakta hai, magar neend nahi khareed sakta ... daulat se insaan roti khareed sakta hai, magar bhook nahi ... daulat se insaan jism khareed sakta hai, magar sacha pyar nahi khareed sakta (-Kajol)
Main toh samajhta tha ki duniya mein mujhse badkar kamina aur koi nahi hai ... lekin tumne end mauke par aaisa kaminapan dikhaya hai ... ki hum tumhare kaminepan ke ghulam ho gaye hai (-Amrish Puri)
Aaisi maut maroonga is kamine ko ... ki bhagwan yeh punar janam waala system hi khatam kar dega (-Amrish Puri)
Bhavnao ki chot jab dil par lagti hai ... toh nafrat ki jwala badakh uthti ha (-Rakhee Gulzar)
Kiss gaalon pe nahi ... hoton pe kiya jata hai (-SRK)
Daayan haath jeb mein rakh lo seth ... varna zindagi bhar aapko baayen haath se khana, khana padega (-Salman Khan)
Pyar mein jab tak maut se na khelo ... milne waali zindagi ka mazaa nahi aata (-SRK)
Ghode par bahetkar jaan ki baazi lagane mein woh maaza nahi ... joh chahat ke maidan mein dil ki baazi laga dene mein hai (-SRK)
Khoon ki Holi khelne waale, aaj main dekhti hoon ... khoon kiska behta hai aur laashein kiski girti hai (-Rakhee Gulzar)
Jab maa ka dil tadapta hai na ... toh aasman mein bhi daraarein padh jati hai (-Rakhee Gulzar)
Paison ke mamle mein main pehdaishi kamina hoon ... dosti aur dushmani ka kya, apno ka khoon bhi pani ki tarah baha deta hoon (-Amrish Puri)
Apne raaste se kaanto ko hata dena aur dushmano ko mita dena ... hamare khandan ki parampara hai (-Amrish Puri)
Main teri maut apni mutthi mein laya hoon (-Unknown)
Tere saare khandaan ki maut ... mere haath ki lakeeron mein likhi hai (-Amrish Puri)
Main toh budhi ho gayi, meri aankhen kamzor ho gayi ... lekin mera vishvas kamzor nahi hua (-Rakhee Gulzar)
Mere andhere jeevan mein ... subah phir se laut aayi hai (-Rakhee Gulzar)
Waqt ka marham ... zindagi ke har zakhm ko bhar deta hai (-Rakhee Gulzar)
Hamare ghar ki bahu betiyan jab kabhi beizzati ke daldal mein kadam rakhti hai ... toh hum unhe haveli ki char deewari mein zinda chunwa dete hai (-Amrish Puri)
Bhudhape mein jism bekaar ho jaate hai ... lekin tune toh apni zindagi hi bekaar kar di (-Amrish Puri)
Marte insaan ki antim ichcha poori karna ... is sansar ka sabse bada punya hove hai (-Ashok Saraf)
Hum khandani Thakur hai ... hamari ragon mein khoon ke saath saath zid aur ahankaar bhi daudta hai (-Amrish Puri)

Apni halat bayaan karoon kaise ... yaad ka saanp dil ko dasta hai ... aahatein goonjti hai kaano mein ... meri aankhon mein koi basta hai ... main tumhe dhoondne kahan jaaon ... koi manzil na koi rasta hai ... meri baahein tumhari manzil hai ... dil musafir hai, pyar rasta hai ... waqt aankhon mein tham gaya jaise ... ek paal ek saal lagta hai ... mere khwaabon ki saans toot na jaaye ... aa bhi jaao ki aas toot na jaaye (-SRK)
Tumhare pyar mein dil bekarar kab se hai ... ab aa bhi jaao, mujhe intezar kab se hai (-SRK)
Aap kamai mein joh maza hai na ... woh maza na baap kamai mein hai, na paap kamai mein hai (-SRK)
Main jab naachta hoon na ... toh pair floor par nahi, haseeno ke dil par padte hai (-SRK)
Har mumkin pehle namumkin hi hota hai ... aur har haqeeqat pehle khwaab hi hoti hai (-Anupam Kher)
Mohabbat ki nahi jaati ... karayi bhi nahi jaati ... mohabbat toh bas khud ba khud ho jaati hai (-Anupam Kher)
Joh humri marzi ke bagair, humre ilaake ki zameen pe apna kadam rakhta hai ... woh apne kadmon pe nahi, balki doosron ke kandhon pe lautke jaata hai (-Shatrughan Sinha)
Badhon ka yarana karane ke liye ... choton ka pyarana bahut zaroori hai (-Anupam Kher)
Poornta se pal pal jeene ko hi asli jeevan kehte hai ... aur poornta se jeene waalon ke liye kabhi maut nahi hoti (-SRK)
Jab ek aurat kisi ko apne dil mein basa leti hai ... toh phir baaki ki rasme toh sirf duniya ke liye reh jaati hai (-Deepti Naval)
Sample pesh karo ... naacho, gaao, seena cheerke dil dikhao, jaan ki baazi lagao, dekha na suna aaisa sapna jagao ... hamara dil behlao (-Deepa Sahi)

Pyar woh nasha hai jis mein chain kho jaata hai, hosh udh jaata hai, neend gayab ho jaati hai ... kisi ko milne ki, chune ki, kehne ki, sunne ki, kisi ko apna banane ki, kisi ka ho jaane ki khawaish hoti hai, jeene ko mann karta hai ... pyar woh andhrooni bahaar hai jis mein kalpana ke phool khilte hai, kavita ko sur milte hai, chahaton ke mele lagte hai, kisse mehakte hai, kah-kahe lagte hai, karaar milta hai ... pyar woh insaani karishma hai jis mein aane waale kal ko wajah milti hai, guzre hue kal ko wajood milta hai, anjaan logon ka dil milta hai, soone safar ko sahil milta hai (-SRK)
Bhook hai, thakaan hai, dard ki pehchaan hai ... dushman jahaan hai, mann bhi pareshaan hai (-SRK)
Yahan tel bhi hai, adalaton mein bail bhi hai ... Kashmir aur Taj Mahal ke saath, suna hai Tihar jail bhi hai (-Raza Murad)
Bandook pakad lene se buzdil bahadur nahi ban jaata ... aur apun darr nahi jaata (-SRK)
Qayamat ki raat ko hum ghoomne ko nikle ... lal chaand nikla hum choomne ko nikle ... arre bhigdi hai apni toh aadat kuch itni ... aadhi raat aafat ko dhoondne ko nikle (-Deepa Sahi)
Humse zabaan ladata hai, hum hi ko kanoon sikhata hai ... chal issi baat par nikaal paise, bachkar jayega kaise ... chal ho ja mushtaid nahi toh aath din ki qaid (-Tiku Talsania)

Kya nahi hai mere paas? ... dekhne mein hero body hai fit, jahan bhi main niklon main superhit ... manner mein style hai, killer sa smile hai, rehta hoon tip-top, niklon toh traffic stop ... society ki shaan hoon, party ki jaan hoon, dancer hoon, dashing fighter hoon, smashing jaanta hoon, heart lover hoon fantastic (-Javed Jaffrey)

Palak jhapakte paasa palat jaata hai, palak jhapakte baazi bighad jaati hai, palak jhapakte kismat badal jaati hai, palak jhapakte pralay aa jaati hai ... jab palak jhapakti hai toh us pal ke liye aadmi soo jaata hai ... aur soona maut ke barabar hota hai (-Amrish Puri)
Bade bade deshon mein aisi choti choti baatein hoti rehti hai (-SRK)
Tumhari jaisi ladki ke saath, mere jaise ladke ka hona ... bahut zaroori hai (-SRK)
Agar yeh tujhe pyar karti hai toh yeh palat ke dekhegi ... palat ... palat! (-SRK)

Agar tum galat raaste par chaloge ... toh ho sakta hai shuruvat mein tumhe bahut kamyabi mile, bahut khushiya mile ... magar anth mein tumhari haar hogi ... aur agar sahi raaste par chaloge ... toh bhale hi shuruvat mein tumhe kadam kadam par thokarein mile, musibaton ka samna karna pade, pareshani ho ... magar anth mein hamesha jeet hogi (-SRK)

Toh kya hua agar maine jhoot sirf tumhe paane ke liye kaha tha ... toh kya hua agar tumhare chehre ke sivah mujhe koi aur chehra dikhai nahi deta ... toh kya hua agar tumhare naam ke sivah mujhe koi aur naam yaad nahi rehta ... toh kya hua agar yeh awara tumhe deewano ki tarah pyar karta hai ... toh kya hua ... pyar sab kuch toh nahi hota na (-SRK)
Ja Simran ... ja jeele apni zindagi ... ja beta ja (-Amrish Puri)
Main ek Hindustani hoon ... aur main jaanta hoon ki ek Hindustani ladki ki izzat kya hoti hai (-SRK)
Joh shaadi waale ghar mein seva karta hai ... usko bahut sundar dulhan milti hai (-SRK)
Jab ladki jawan ho jaati hai na ... toh maa uski maa nahi rehti ... sehali ban jaati hai (-Farida Jalal)
Sapne dekho, zaroor dekho ... bus unke poore hone ki shart mat rakho (-Farida Jalal)
Koi bhi ullu ka patha sirf ek angoothi pehanakar tumko mujhse nahi cheen sakta ... tum meri ho, sirf meri (-SRK)
Ek pal mein beta bana liya ... aur doosre hi pal mein paraya kar diya (-SRK)
Mohabbat ka naam aaj bhi mohabbat hai ... yeh na kabhi badli hai aur na kabhi badlegi (-Anupam Kher)
Insaan ki umar utni hi hoti hai jitni woh feel karta hai (-Unknown)
Fail hona aur padhai na karna ... hamare khandaan ki parampara hai (-Anupam Kher)
Zarooraton ne par kaat diye hai ... roti paon ki zanjeer ban gayi hai (-Amrish Puri)
Dimaag mein kitaaben bharne se jeben thodhi bharti hai (-Anupam Kher)
Oonchi building mein rehne waala footpath pe chalne waala ka khoon choosta hai (-SRK)
Humse aankhen milane wala ... bahut jaldi aankhen bandh kar deta hai (-Gulshan Grover)
Yeh apun ka style hai kya ... jiyo toh seena taan ke jiyo ... maro toh seena taan ke maro (-SRK)
Joh maidan mein ghutne tek de woh dosti karne ke kabil nahi re (-SRK)
Dil mein ghusne se pehle ladki log knock kaiko nahi karta hai re? (-SRK)
Apun to khud saala maut hai ... is liye aaj talak zindagi ka himmat nahi pada ... ki apun ko nazdeek se aakar dekhe (-SRK)
Jise doosron ka pyar milta hai ... woh bada kismat waala hota hai (-Unknown)
Tu is duniya mein first time aake itna nahi roya hoyenga ... jitna tu aaj is duniya se jaate time royenga (-SRK)
Panga unse liya jaata hai ... joh apne se zyada taqatwar ho (-Gulshan Grover)
Jahan par dus log kaam karenga ... wahan pe ek na ek gaddar to zaroor niklenga (-SRK)
Tumhari zabaan chahe joh kahe ... main tumhari aankhen padh sakti hoon (-Juhi Chawla)
Yeh zindagi tera karz hai mujhpar ... jab chahe hisaab chuka lena (-Vivek Mushran)
Joh khud mirchi ho unhe mirchi nahi lagti (-Unknown)
Duniya uske liye lutao jiski duniya sooni hai (-Vivek Mushran)
Aadmi zabaan se kuch kehta hai ... dimaag se kuch aur sochta hai ... aur dil kuch aur hi chahta hai (-Anil Kapoor)
Agar halaat ke ghulam banoge na, toh duniya tumhe kutta samajhkar laat maregi ... lekin agar halaat ko apna ghulam banaoge na, toh duniya tumhe sher samajhkar salaam karegi (-Priya Tendulkar)
Kal shyam aur thi, aaj shyam aur hai ... kal thikaane aur the, aaj manzil aur hai (-Anil Kapoor)
Mohabbat aur jurrat kya cheez hai, yeh tu kya janega kasai ... yeh deewana bankar rahega, tumhara permanent jamai (-SRK)
Joh chala gaya usse bhool ja ... joh aa raha hai usse pyar kar (-Anil Kapoor)
Woh tujhe mil jayegi ... tere dil ki kali khil jayegi (-Mohan Agashe)
Is duniya mein har insaan ko khud ladna padta hai ... khud haarna aur khud hi jeetna padta hai (-Priya Tendulkar)
Bhaage hamare dushman meri jaan, hum mein rukna hoga ... hamari mohabbat ke aage, in kamino ko jhukna hoga (-SRK)
Aasoon kamzor logon ke zevar hote hai (-Anil Kapoor)
Is duniya mein kisi bhi cheez ko haasil karne ke liye teen tarike ki power chahiye ... money power, political power, muscle power (-Anil Kapoor)
Pareshani aur takleefon se joh door ho, woh hum hai ... jiske sar par aapka haath ho, usse kya gham hai (-SRK)
Ghalib na mara tha, na mara hai, na marega ... kyun ki aashiq ka bachcha na sudhra hai, na sudhrega (-SRK)
Mujhe teri aankh, kaan, naak bilkul pasand nahi ... mujhe toh teri muskurahat se pyar hai (-SRK)
Koi janam insaan ka janam nahi paoge tum ... shraap deti hoon tumhe! (-Sonali Bendre)
Jin gande haatho se tumne Bijuriya ke jism ko chua hai ... unhi haatho ko jodhkar tumhe usse maafi mangni padegi (-SRK)
Aapki kabr bhi main apne haatho se khodoonga ... aur aapko dafnaonga bhi main apne haatho se (-SRK)
Bharatiya duniya ke kisi bhi desh ... apna tann dhokar le jaye ... unka mann Bharat nahi chodta (-Unknown)
Agar aap log mera saath chhodkar gaye ... toh zindagi aap logon ka saath chhod degi (-Sridevi)
Duniya mein koi bhoot pret, koi jungli janwar is insaan naam ke janwar se zyada khatarnak nahi hota ... nuksaan toh sirf jeete jaagte insaan hi pahunchate hai (-Sridevi)
Badle ke aag mein jalti hui naari aur chot khai hui nagin ... dono ek samaan hoti hai (-Danny Denzongpa)
Bholenath ki teesri aankh hai hum ... aur jab yeh aankh khulti hai toh zindagi maut mein badal jaati hai (-Danny Denzongpa)
Lohe ke darwaze taqat se tootte na tootte ... akal se khule zaroor ja sakte hai (-Sridevi)
Jab insaan nasha karko haivaan ban jaata ... toh haivaan nasha karko shaitaan hi banega na (-SRK)
Horror shows, horror novels kabhi mat padna ... dimaag ke khaate mein haddiyon ka dhancha nazar aata hai (-Johnny Lever)
Koyle ko kitna bhi sabun lagao ... woh kaala ka kaala hi rahega (-Jeetendra)
Ghaas aur dushmani kahin bhi aur kabhi bhi pehda ho sakte hai (-Amrish Puri)

Main inteqam ka ek aaisa dahekta hua koyla hoon ... jiski uthti hui aag ki lapton mein tum sabki zindagiyan aa chuki hai ... aur is jalte hue koyle ki aag mein tum sab bari-bari jalkar raakh ho jaoge (-SRK)
